class.name: Auth
class.brief_description: Authentication manager for API keys and OAuth with itch.io.
class.description:
Handles acquisition and storage of credentials used for itch.io API calls. Sources include: - the itch launcher (environment variable [code]ITCHIO_API_KEY[/code]) - an OAuth access token obtained via the authorization flow
Provides helpers to configure the OAuth client, start the browser-based flow, and retrieve a unified bearer token for use in HTTP requests.

method.name: build_oauth_authorize_url
method.description: Builds and returns the OAuth authorization URL for itch.io using the provided `client_id`, `redirect_uri`, and optional `state` parameter.

method.name: get_bearer_token
method.description: Returns the current bearer token, preferring an OAuth token if present, otherwise the launcher API key. Returns an empty string if no credential is available.

method.name: get_launch_api_key
method.description: Returns an API key provided by the launcher (if the game was started via the itch app), otherwise returns an empty string.

method.name: get_oauth_client_id
method.description: Returns the OAuth client ID used for user authorization.

method.name: get_oauth_redirect_uri
method.description: Returns the OAuth redirect URI used after user authorization.

method.name: get_oauth_scope
method.description: Returns the OAuth scope string requested during authorization.

method.name: get_oauth_token
method.description: Returns the current OAuth access token if available, otherwise an empty string.

method.name: has_api_key_present
method.description: Returns true if an API key is available either from configuration or via the itch launcher.

method.name: has_bearer_token
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if either an OAuth token or a launcher API key is available.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns true if the authentication subsystem has been initialized.

method.name: is_launched_via_itch
method.description: Returns true if the game was launched through the itch.io app and launcher information is available.

method.name: set_oauth_client_id
method.description: Sets the OAuth client ID used to identify your application.

method.name: set_oauth_redirect_uri
method.description: Sets the OAuth redirect URI registered for your application.

method.name: set_oauth_scope
method.description: Sets the OAuth scope string to request during authorization.

method.name: set_oauth_token
method.description: Sets the OAuth access token obtained from the authorization flow.

method.name: start_oauth_authorization
method.description: Starts the OAuth authorization process using the provided parameters. Typically opens a browser to the authorization URL.

signal.name: auth_error
signal.description: Emitted when an authentication-related network call fails or returns an error.

signal.name: auth_result
signal.description: Emitted after an authentication-related HTTP call completes (e.g., [code]credentials/info[/code]). [code]data[/code] contains the parsed response.
